creative_direction.name: Aqua Ripple Sonar Plate
creative_direction.brief: 把 Aqua 的水声读作一圈声呐回波：平涂冰川水蓝卡纸上，细密同心水蓝刻线环自画面中心向外扩散，一枚硬边深青矩形板沉于环心之后托住剪影下半，环线下三分之一被一道硬边留白横带截断如同回波沉入铭牌；商品提至上幅立于环心，刻线从其肩后继续垂落却不触碰标签。下幅留出完整宽铭牌带：宽距 Arial 品牌字居带顶，Century Gothic 几何大写题名以两行宽排收左缘起排，一条深青细线横垫区底如声呐刻度——题名整组起排于瓶底之下，构成 BELOW 关系。无地面无 horizon，纯环密度扩散叙事对抗金黄液体的暖透。参考 R2 的纸面分区铭牌秩序、R5 的圆心聚焦光环与 R1 的深色铭牌对比层级。
creative_direction.material: flat matte screen-printed card with fine concentric ripple rings and one hard-edge blank plaque band
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat matte screen-printed card in pale glacier aqua blue, fine concentric ripple rings in deep marine teal expanding from the exact centre of the frame, one hard-edge blank horizontal plaque band without rings across the lower quarter, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, no texture gradients beyond printed rings, no objects
